description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LDAPSyncService, specifically testing the creation of system users in an LDAP integration context within the OrangeHRM application. It includes multiple test methods that verify user creation, updating existing users, handling employee mapping, and duplicate handling scenarios.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing system user creation functionality in LDAP synchronization within the OrangeHRM environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets fixture directory, mocks datetime, and configures services.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests creating system users from LDAP data, verifying counts after operation.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithLocalUsers
methods.description: Tests creation when local users are already present, verifying count increments.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithEmployeeMapping
methods.description: Tests capture of employee attribute mapping during LDAP sync.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenUsernameChanged
methods.description: Ensures user update handling when LDAP username has changed.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsNotChanged
methods.description: Tests that no updates occur when LDAP data matches existing user data.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsChanged
methods.description: Verifies employee data updates when LDAP record fields have changed.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithNonUniqueEmployeeIdAndWorkEmail
methods.description: Tests handling of duplicate employee IDs and work emails in LDAP data.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Helper method to generate a list of LDAPUser objects with mock LDAP entries for testing.
